floorPlans.introduction: Explore eight complete original home drawings with printed NET areas, full-size zoom and physical PDF-page links.

floorPlans.note: Eight complete original brochure drawings retain their printed NET AREA labels. They include pool and non-pool studios, 1 BR homes, and 1 BR/2 BR pool duplexes with both levels shown. This original document’s variants and areas differ from the current broad studio/1 BR/2 BR categories and 365 sq ft minimum. Confirm the applicable release, numbered unit, approved area definition and pool provision. No current availability is implied. An accessible complete building floorplate or numbered-unit pack was not established in the reviewed sources.

review.imagery: Twenty-three original-project renders cover the tower, shared leisure deck, roof, lobby, fitness facilities and home interiors. All 58 extracted brochure resources and six current gallery images were visually reviewed. Repeated layers, ocean decoration, unrelated portfolio pages and generic car imagery are excluded. The native page-6 tower view supplies the hero and listing image with top alignment. Shared amenities retain Waves-complex scope. Rendered fitout and views are not matched to an exact unit.
review.floorPlans: Eight complete original brochure drawings retain their printed NET AREA labels. They include pool and non-pool studios, 1 BR homes, and 1 BR/2 BR pool duplexes with both levels shown. This original document’s variants and areas differ from the current broad studio/1 BR/2 BR categories and 365 sq ft minimum. Confirm the applicable release, numbered unit, approved area definition and pool provision. No current availability is implied. An accessible complete building floorplate or numbered-unit pack was not established in the reviewed sources. All complete physical drawing pages 42, 43, 45, 47, 49, 51, 53 and 55 and their printed numerical panels were visually reviewed. All eight NET areas are visibly supported. Room-render moodboards on alternating pages remain available in the original PDF and are excluded from drawing choices. Phase II unit sheets are not assigned to this original project.
review.location: Both complete brochure location pages 25–26 were visually reviewed. The neighbourhood map retains all source content and scope. All eight printed times are transcribed and current-primary conflicts are explicit. The name-only primary map query is recorded with HTML hash. No entrance coordinate, direct plot frontage or live route is inferred.
review.provenance: Primary HTML, official original brochure bytes and native-gallery origins retain source receipts and hashes. Complete sheets keep branding and physical PDF-page links. Portal mirrors of the original brochure corroborate the document identity. Restricted download forms were not submitted. Protected identity and completed text research remain intact.

unavailable: A complete numbered-unit/building floorplate pack, approved contractual area mapping, variant applicability, visitor entrance coordinates, dated construction photographs, exact unit finish/views and live journey times were not established.
